privacy.title: 개인정보 처리방침
privacy.hero_subtitle: We are committed to protecting your absolute privacy and ensuring the unbreakable security of your documents.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Welcome to DocsGuard. We are committed to protecting your absolute privacy and ensuring the unbreakable security of your documents. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is handled when you use our mobile application ("DocsGuard" or the "App").

sections.title: 2. The Core Principle: Zero-Knowledge & Local Processing
sections.content: Our fundamental philosophy is that your data belongs exclusively to you. DocsGuard is engineered with a strictly local-processing architecture.
list: No Cloud Servers for Files: We do not upload, transmit, store, or process any of your documents, photos, or videos on any remote servers.
On-Device Operation: All document editing, watermarking, and security features are executed entirely locally on your device's hardware.
Zero Access: Our developers, employees, and company have absolutely zero access to the files you import or modify using DocsGuard.

sections.title: 3. Information We Collect for Support Management
sections.content: DocsGuard operates entirely without user accounts; you do not need to register, provide an email, or log in to use the App or purchase Premium features. While your documents and files remain strictly local, we collect minimal information only if you voluntarily contact us for customer support:
list: Customer Support and Feedback Data: If you submit a complaint, inquiry, or feedback through our "Contact us" Page, we securely collect and store your Name, Email Address, and the contents of your message in our secure database.

Purpose of Collection: Support data is stored exclusively to analyze, process, and respond to your complaints or inquiries via our official support email. We do not use this information for marketing, nor do we ever sell it to data brokers.

sections.title: 4. Information We Do Not Collect
sections.content: To ensure absolute clarity, DocsGuard does not collect, store, or share:
list: The contents of your documents, images, PDFs, or videos.
Any Personally Identifiable Information (PII) beyond the explicit support data mentioned in Section 3.

sections.title: 5. Data Collected by Third-Party Services (Advertising & Diagnostics)
sections.content: We integrate highly trusted industry-standard third-party SDKs to monetize the free tier of the App and manage payments. These services handle data as follows:
list: Subscription Management (Apple App Store / RevenueCat): Used securely to verify your purchase history and validate your current subscription tier. This data is not linked to your real-world identity.

Advertising (Google AdMob): To support our free features, the App displays advertisements served by Google AdMob. AdMob may collect and use device identifiers (such as the iOS Advertising Identifier or IDFA) and usage data (such as ad interactions) to deliver personalized ads, measure ad performance, and prevent fraud. This tracking only occurs if you explicitly grant permission via the iOS App Tracking Transparency prompt.

Native Diagnostics (Apple App Analytics): We do not use third-party analytics or crash reporting SDKs (such as Firebase). We only receive anonymous, aggregate crash logs and performance metrics provided natively by Apple if you have opted-in via your iOS device settings to share diagnostic data with developers.

sections.title: 6. Subscriptions and Payment Processing
sections.content: All financial transactions are handled securely and directly by the Apple App Store. DocsGuard does not process, store, or have access to your payment information, credit card numbers, or billing addresses. Because DocsGuard does not require user accounts, all subscription purchases, premium access, and purchase restorations are tied strictly and directly to your personal Apple ID. You can seamlessly restore your purchases on a new device by using the Apple ID associated with the original transaction.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
sections.content: Because we do not have user accounts, there is no profile data to retain. We retain your support history only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.
list: Your Right to Delete: You have the right to request the complete deletion of your submitted support messages and contact email from our database at any time.

Subscription Management: Please note that deleting your support history with us does not automatically cancel active App Store subscriptions; you must manage and cancel those directly within your Apple ID store settings.

sections.title: 8. User Rights (GDPR & CCPA Compliance)
sections.content: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), users have the right to request access, modification, or deletion of their data. Because DocsGuard operates locally and does not store your files on our servers, your right to erasure of your files is completely in your control. To delete all your documents associated with DocsGuard, simply delete the files from your device or uninstall the App. For your support data deletion, please refer to Section 7.

sections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our App is a professional document security tool and is not directed at individuals under the age of 13 (or the applicable legal age in your region). We do not knowingly collect any personal information from children. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected personal data from a child, we will take immediate steps to delete such information from our databases.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. The updated policy will be accessible within the App settings.

sections.title: 11. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how DocsGuard handles your privacy, please reach out to us directly through our "Contact us" page located within the App. Once you submit your inquiry, our support team will review your case and respond directly to the email address you provided.

learn_more.title: 완전 기억상실 개인정보 처리방침
learn_more.hero_subtitle: DocsGuard는 세상에서 가장 안전한 문서 도구가 되도록 설계되었습니다. 저희는 귀하의 파일을 전혀 볼 수 없습니다.

amnesia.title: 완전 기억상실
amnesia.description: 앱을 닫거나 세션을 종료하는 즉시 문서의 모든 흔적이 메모리에서 삭제됩니다. 귀하의 개인 콘텐츠에 대한 기록, 로그 또는 캐시를 보관하지 않습니다.

on_device.title: 100% 온디바이스
on_device.description: 파일은 절대로 휴대전화를 떠나지 않습니다. 모든 워터마크, 블러 및 암호화는 기기의 하드웨어를 사용하여 로컬에서 이루어집니다.

zero_cloud.title: 제로 클라우드
zero_cloud.description: 문서를 저장하기 위한 서버가 없습니다. 클라우드가 없기 때문에 클라우드 '업로드' 버튼도 없습니다. 귀하의 데이터는 귀하의 소유입니다.

zero_selling.title: 판매 제로
zero_selling.description: 데이터를 수집하지 않으므로 판매할 것도 없습니다. 저희의 비즈니스 모델은 개인 정보가 아닌 구독을 기반으로 합니다.

learn_more.commitment_description: DocsGuard는 프라이버시가 기본적인 인권이라고 믿습니다. 기존의 '무료' 문서 도구는 종종 서버에서 파일을 처리하며, 잠재적으로 AI 모델을 교육하거나 프로필을 작성합니다. 저희는 반대 접근 방식을 취합니다.
features: 개인 파일에 대한 제3자 분석 없음
learn_more.technical_description: 워터마크를 적용하거나 영역을 흐리게 처리할 때 브라우저의 Canvas API 또는 기본 모바일 API를 사용합니다. 결과 파일은 메모리에서 생성되어 다운로드용으로 제공됩니다. 창이나 앱을 닫으면 해당 메모리는 운영 체제에 의해 해제됩니다.
learn_more.contact_description: 저희의 '완전 기억상실' 정책에 대해 질문이 있는 경우 보안 팀에 문의할 수 있습니다. 저희는 최고의 온디바이스 프라이버시 표준을 유지하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다.

benefits_details.title: 무제한 문서 보호
benefits_details.description: 수백 페이지의 PDF에 워터마크를 수초 만에 동시에 추가하세요. 3페이지 제한에서 벗어나 무거운 업무를 즉시 처리할 수 있습니다.

benefits_details.title: 무제한 비디오 워터마크 (원본 품질)
benefits_details.description: 비디오를 시간 제한에서 해방시키세요. 100% 원본 품질을 보장하며 긴 비디오에 워터마크를 넣을 수 있습니다. 해상도 손실이나 압축이 전혀 없습니다.

benefits_details.title: 고급 PDF 암호화 (PDF Vault)
benefits_details.description: 보안 로컬 암호화로 민감한 문서를 잠그세요. 계약서, 재무 보고서 및 개인 데이터를 승인된 사람만 액세스할 수 있도록 보장합니다.

benefits_details.title: 스마트 블러
benefits_details.description: 기밀 정보를 숨기세요! 공유하기 전에 문서나 이미지의 특정 영역(은행 계좌나 ID 번호 등)을 영구적으로 블러 처리합니다.

benefits_details.title: 우선 처리 및 광고 제거
benefits_details.description: 깨끗하고 집중된 인터페이스를 즐기세요. 성가신 광고가 전혀 없는 더 빠른 온디바이스 처리를 경험해 보세요.
